o1: Enables protein kinase binding activity. Involved in endoplasmic reticulum organization; positive regulation of endocytic recycling; regulation of Golgi organization; and negative regulation of microtubule severing during mitosis and meiosis. Located in cytoplasm; cytoplasmic side of apical plasma membrane; and growing cell tip. Is expressed in excretory cell; head; intestine; pharynx; and reproductive system. Interacts with GCK-1; FARL-11; SLMP-1; LET-92; and CASH-1. Used to study cerebral cavernous malformation. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cerebral cavernous malformation 3. Orthologous to human PDCD10 (programmed cell death 10).
